bias.zh: 上升趋势完好 · 反弹靠近 $748

read.en: Meta rose 3.4% on Oct 12 to $742.96 on above-average volume, back above its 5 and 10-day averages ($729–730) and well above the 30-day ($689), 100-day ($623) and 200-day ($631). MACD is still below its signal, but the histogram has started to narrow. Parabolic SAR remains bearish at $765, and RSI is 62.
read.zh: Meta 10月12日放量上涨 3.4%，收于 $742.96，重新站上 5 日和 10 日均线（$729–730），并远高于 30 日（$689）、100 日（$623）和 200 日均线（$631）。MACD 仍在信号线下方，但柱体已开始收窄。抛物线 SAR 仍看空于 $765，RSI 为 62。

read.en: The rally pushed through the $728 resistance from the last read but stalled at $752 intraday, just above the Oct 6 high of $748. A close above $752 would bring SAR ($765) into play and then the $780 record. Support is $729–730 (5 and 10-day averages), then $712 (Oct 8 low) and the 30-day average near $689.
read.zh: 此轮反弹突破了上次解读中的 $728 阻力，但盘中在 $752 受阻，略高于 10月6日高点 $748。若收盘站上 $752，将挑战 SAR（$765），再看 $780 纪录高点。支撑为 $729–730（5 日和 10 日均线），其次 $712（10月8日低点）及约 $689 的 30 日均线。
